questions.stemEnglish: Find the cardinal number of the following sets.
questions.promptEnglish: (i) M = {p, q, r, s, t, u}
stepsEnglish: The cardinal number of a finite set is the number of distinct elements in it.
The elements of M are p, q, r, s, t and u; each is different.
Counting these six elements gives n(M) = 6.

verification.method: Independent distinct-element enumeration and Set cardinality check
